paragraphs: Here's the big idea, friend: when trouble comes, take it to the LORD. Israel got hit by the king of Arad, and some of them were taken prisoner. So what did they do? They made a vow to the LORD and asked for His help (Numbers 21:1-2).

Now look at who they asked: they said, "If You will deliver this people into our hands…" (Numbers 21:2). Then the text says, "the LORD heard Israel's plea and delivered up the Canaanites" (Numbers 21:3). He heard them, friend. HEARD them.

And then Israel kept the vow, which is the hard part, because making a promise in a tight spot is easy (Numbers 21:3). So here's my question for you, baker: what have you said to the LORD that you haven't gotten around to doing yet? I've left plenty of things half-done on my own counter, so I'm not throwing stones. Bring your trouble to Him, trust Him to hear you, and then do what you said you'd do.
